entity.name: Scuttlebutt Pub
entity.address_line_1: 319 A N McKenzie St, Foley, AL 36535
entity.description: Scuttlebutt Pub is Foley's hometown pub where you enter as a stranger and leave as a friend. The ultimate Foley bar experience featuring live jazz, karaoke, pool, and giant Jenga games on their outdoor patio with a diverse drink menu including craft cocktails, classic cocktails, prohibition-style cocktails, old fashioneds, whiskey drinks, bourbon cocktails, signature shooters, shot specials, and fun bar drinks.
entity.atmosphere: Vibrant, friendly neighborhood pub with outdoor patio featuring games like pool and giant Jenga. Live entertainment venue.
